transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I guess what scared me enough to actually come in today is... I just keep thinking it would be easier if I didn't wake up. And, um, sometimes when I'm driving home from the clinic, I catch myself just wondering what would happen if I didn't turn the wheel. It's been happening enough that I knew I needed to talk to somebody.
How long have you been feeling this way?

I'd say it's been about a month. We had to take in a relative recently, and... well, it's just been this really intense, up-and-down crisis around all of that. So, yeah, this has been going on for about a month now.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

Yes, I have. Um... I haven't even touched my camera lately. And I usually keep a close eye on the bird feeders, but I just haven't checked them with any real interest. I don't even care what's coming up in the garden right now. It's... well, it's actually really frightening to me, because those things used to be how I felt like myself.
Have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past month?

Yes, I have. Most days, actually. It just feels like... like the color has completely drained out of everything. Even with the house being so busy right now, I just feel this heavy sadness all day. I actually end up going into the laundry room to cry a lot of the time. I just... I can't stand the thought of anyone in the family seeing how completely hopeless I feel.
Have you ever felt this way before, with a similar kind of sadness or loss of interest, or is this the first time you've experienced something like this?

Yes, I have. Um... it's definitely not the first time. Actually, this whole feeling, this depression, has been hanging over me for about 11 months now. It started way before all the recent family stuff. It's just that this past month... well, it really escalated and made everything feel completely unbearable. But yeah, it's been going on for almost a year.
Can you tell me more about the time when this depression first started? Were there any specific events or changes in your life then that might have contributed to it?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I've tried to look back and figure that out, but... there wasn't any specific event or big change that triggered it. About 11 months ago, everything in my life was pretty much normal. Work was fine, home was fine. It just... it just sort of started creeping in on its own, for no obvious reason.
In the past year, have there been any periods where you felt like you were back to your usual self and not experiencing these depressive symptoms, even for a few weeks or a couple of months?

No, I... I really haven't. Since it started those 11 months ago, it's just been constant. There haven't been any weeks or months where I felt like my old self again, or where the sadness lifted. It's just been this same heavy feeling every single day without any real break.
Have you ever experienced a period of time where you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or irritable, where you didn't need much sleep or felt like you didn't need any sleep at all?

Yes, I did have something like that recently. Earlier this month, I had a period where I felt almost... electrically upbeat. But then it turned into me just snapping at everyone over tiny things. 

Like at work, if someone misplaced a medication cup or if there was a slight change in the morning schedule, I would just get incredibly irritated and go off on them. It really didn't feel like my usual self at all.
How long did that upbeat, electric feeling last when you were snapping at people over small things?

I'm not exactly sure how long it lasted, to be honest. I didn't really track the days. It was just a stretch of time earlier this month where I felt that way, but I couldn't give you a specific number of days or weeks.
Can you estimate how many days or weeks that upbeat, electric feeling lasted earlier this month before it started to fade or shift into something else?

I really can't give you a good estimate, I'm sorry. I... I know you're looking for a specific timeframe, but time has just been such a blur lately. 

It might have been a few days, or maybe a week? I honestly just didn't pay enough attention to the calendar to tell you exactly when it started and when it faded out. I just know it was earlier this month.
Can you think back and tell me if that upbeat, electric feeling you had earlier this month lasted for a full week or longer?
I really don't know if it was a full week. Like I said, it might have been, but I just... I can't say for sure. I wasn't keeping track of the days like that.
Can you tell me whether that upbeat, electric feeling you had earlier this month lasted for at least four days?

I just... I really can't say for sure. Four days, a week... I know I keep repeating myself, but I honestly don't know. I just didn't track it. It was just a period of time where I felt like that, and I can't pin down exactly how many days it was.
Can you recall if there was a time when you felt unusually high or energized for at least four days in a row, without needing much sleep?

Yes, I do remember the sleep part clearly. During that high-energy stretch, I was sleeping maybe... three hours a night? But I'd still wake up before sunrise feeling completely sharp. I was just convinced I didn't really need any more rest than that.
Can you tell me if that high-energy, upbeat feeling you had earlier this month happened for at least four days in a row without a break?

I know you're really trying to nail down the exact number of days... but I just don't have a clear answer for that. It was definitely one continuous stretch—it didn't, you know, come and go—but whether it was exactly four days in a row, or three, or five... I honestly can't give you a firm yes or no. I just know it was a solid block of time where I had all that energy and wasn't sleeping.
Can you tell me if your elevated mood and high energy during that time happened every day without a break for at least four consecutive days?

I feel like we're going in circles a bit with this. I really don't have a different answer to give you. Yes, it happened every day without a break—it didn't just stop for a few hours and come back. But as for it being exactly four consecutive days... I just don't know. I wasn't marking it on a calendar. It was a solid block of days, but I can't guarantee it was four.
Can you think back and tell me if your elevated mood and high energy happened every single day without a break for at least four full days in a row?

I really don't know how else to say it. I've told you everything I can remember about it. It was a continuous stretch, yes, every single day without a break. But I cannot tell you if it was exactly four full days in a row. I just don't have that specific detail for you.
Can you confirm whether your elevated mood and high energy happened every single day for at least four consecutive days without breaking?

Doctor, I'm really trying to be helpful here, but I just don't have the answer you're looking for. I can't confirm it was four days. I know it didn't stop once it started, it was just one long stretch... but I didn't count the days. I just can't give you a yes or no on the number four.
Can you confirm whether your elevated mood and high energy happened every single day for at least four consecutive days without stopping?

Doctor, I... I really don't know what else I can say at this point. We've gone over this several times now. Yes, it was every day. Yes, it was without stopping. But I cannot tell you if it was exactly four days. I just don't know. I didn't track it like that. I've given you all the information I have on this.
